visualScore: Front and perspective renders show a genuinely convincing pillow silhouette: real cushion volume, characteristic pinched/pointed corners, correct proportions. No rotation correction needed -- already oriented upright, unlike the hoodie. CORRECTION to an earlier impression: the apparent 'woven fabric texture' in the renders is NOT a real texture -- this material has no base color or normal map at all, just a flat gray factor. What looked like weave detail was this project's flat-shaded audit renderer showing the mesh's own triangulation density, not an actual texture map. Expect flat/untextured appearance in the real engine until a print-area decal or a real fabric texture is added. Silhouette quality: high. Material readiness: not yet -- needs a texture or relies entirely on the generated portrait decal for visual interest.
